evidence.quote: To connect your VPC to CloudWatch services, you define an *interface VPC endpoint* for your VPC. The endpoint provides reliable, scalable connectivity to CloudWatch and supported CloudWatch services without requiring an internet gateway, network address translation (NAT) instance, or VPN connection.
Interface VPC endpoints are powered by AWS PrivateLink, an AWS technology that enables private communication between AWS services using an elastic network interface with private IP addresses.
